question: According to the Census of India 2011, India’s decadal growth rate was _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__17.7%__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The decadal growth rate from 2001-2011 was recorded as 17.64%.
 
• Top 5 states with the highest decadal growth rate.
 
• The lowest decadal growth rate can be found in Nagaland (-0.5%).
 
• The first census was conducted in 1872 at the time of Viceroy Lord Mayo.
 
• India is the second largest populated country in the world.
 
• The approximate population in India according to the 2011 census is 122 crore.
 
• 51.54% are Male, and 48.46% are Female.
 
• The sex ratio is 943.
 
• The child sex ratio is **919**.
 
• The Literacy rate is approx 74.04%. Of which Male are 82.10% and Female are 65.46%.
